name: Dekakute Ecchi na Ore no Ane
original_name: デカくてエッチな俺の姉
source: The protagonist is called back home after being away for a long time. His memories of his brocon sisters being all over him makes him anxious to why he is being called back. Upon his arrival he is told his sisters caught special disease that makes them horny and the only cure is regular dosage of sperm. They specifically choose him to be the man to donate the sperm.
translation: 主人公离家多年后被叫回家中。想到那些极度恋兄的姐姐们曾经围着自己纠缠不休，他不禁疑惑家人为什么突然召他回来。回家后，他得知姐姐们患上了一种特殊疾病，会变得异常好色，而唯一的治疗方法就是定期摄入精液。她们特意选中了主人公，让他负责提供精液。
